title: WNBA Data Completeness Repair V1 Step 2 — exact selected-day handoff
problem: Fresh public WNBA Game Center still shows 13.3/14.3 MIN with 0.0 PTS/REB/AST/PRA even though the current-main exact-day player hydrator returns real production for 56 of 58 roster players.
root_cause: wnba_availability_v27._verified_pool_for_day receives an exact selected day but discards it when it calls players.player_form_table(year). player_form_table ignores the year argument for day selection and instead reads Streamlit session date or today, allowing the verified availability pool to hydrate a different day and then zero-fill unmatched roster rows.
patch: Hand the exact requested day_str directly to the already-proven players._build_selected_player_pool(day_str) and consume its returned frame; do not change navigation, role/model math, probability, market, sportsbook, or other sports.
